title: Iron ore tube vein in a boat pit

tellings.quote: So here I'm down inside of one of these {quote} {unquote} boat pits. Mhm. And this is an image This is a tube.

plain: Down inside one of the so-called boat pits cut into the rock of the Giza Plateau beside the pyramids of Egypt, the researcher Jeffrey Drum says he found a tube, a vein of iron ore, and he shows Michels a photograph of it. He says he was there himself, and he uses "boat pit" in quotes because he doubts that was the pits' purpose. He offers it as part of his case that a vast energy grid lies beneath the pyramids.
